name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
description: A 5th-century rock fortress built by King Kashyapa, rising 200 m above the surrounding plains.

name: Ella
description: A hill-country village known for hiking trails, tea estates and the Nine Arches Bridge.

name: Yala National Park
description: Sri Lanka's most visited national park, famous for its high density of leopards, elephants and birdlife.

name: Mirissa
description: A relaxed southern beach town with golden sand, palm-fringed bays and seasonal whale watching.

name: Galle Fort
description: A 17th-century Dutch fortified old town on the southwest coast, filled with cafes, boutiques and sea-view ramparts.

name: Anuradhapura Sacred City
description: Sri Lanka's first ancient capital, with giant dagobas, sacred bodhi tree and 2,000 years of Buddhist history.

name: Arugam Bay
description: A laid-back east-coast surf town with world-class point breaks and quiet lagoon beaches nearby.

name: Nuwara Eliya
description: A cool hill-country town surrounded by tea plantations, waterfalls and colonial-era architecture.

name: Minneriya National Park
description: Home to The Gathering, one of the largest seasonal congregations of wild Asian elephants in the world.

name: Horton Plains National Park
description: A high-altitude plateau of grassland and cloud forest, with a scenic trail to World's End and Baker's Falls.
